mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ff_flag_config (flag_id, environment_id, enabled, default_variant_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{flagId}, #{environmentId}, #{enabled}, #{defaultVariantId}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
